title: The Power of a Jedi Knight
front_description: Obi-Wan rushes to the aid of his semi-conscious apprentice, lightsaber flashing. Although a brilliant swordsman and expert fighter, the courageous Jedi is outmatched by the far more powerful and experienced Count Dooku. "Master Kenobi, you disappoint me!" taunts the Count as he and Obi-Wan duel in the hangar tower. "Yoda holds you in such high esteem." As Kenobi weakens, Dooku increases the tempo of his attack.
back_description: An intense Obi-Wan (Ewan McGregor) clashes with Jedi-gone-bad Dooku (Christopher Lee).
